newsitem.title: USA: Savannah Foods ups annual div to $0.15.
newsitem.headline: Savannah Foods ups annual div to $0.15.

text.p: Savannah Foods & Industries Inc said Thursday its board approved a 50 percent dividend increase because of the improvement in the company's earnings for its second fiscal quarter ended March 30.
The company said the annual dividend rate was increased to $0.15 from from $0.10 per share.
It said the board declared the next regular quarterly dividend of $.0375 per share payable June 27, 1997 to shareholders of record at the close of business on June 6, 1997.
The company reported earnings for the quarter were $8.829 million or $0.34 per share, on revenues of $276.489 million.
For the first half of its fiscal year, the company earned $17.977 million, or $0.69 per share, on revenues of $579.610 million.

It said this compares to a loss in last year's March quarter of $2.043 million or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $250.804 million and earnings for the first six months of fiscal 1996 of $1.500 million, or $0.06 per share, on revenues of $555.213 million.
